title: Velvety Caramelized Chinese Frankfurter Dim Sum
description: A lazy Sunday Chinese dish featuring caramelized frankfurters in a citrusy cheese sauce, served in dim sum form, egg-free and friendly for all to enjoy. This Shandong-inspired dish is perfect for a relaxing weekend meal.
instructions: In a large skillet, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced Chinese frankfurters and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the granulated sugar, soy sauce, and rice vinegar to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the frankfurters are caramelized.
In a separate bowl, mix the shredded mozzarella cheese with chopped green onions and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Lay a dim sum wrapper on a flat surface and place a small spoonful of the caramelized frankfurter mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Top the frankfurter mixture with a small spoonful of the cheese mixture.
Fold the dim sum wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point, and press the edges together to seal the dim sum.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients.
Serve the Velvety Caramelized Chinese Frankfurter Dim Sum warm and enjoy.
